messages:
Dana M.: FYI HelioCore sent INV-9912 for Sept. PDF has no PO and the invoice is billed in GBP but our PO and GL are USD. Its sitting in AP with a hold. Anyone who owns this spend?
Priya S.: I pulled the file. Lines: subscription £4,200, setup £1,200. No PO on header but vendor email references PO# 2025-ENG-01 (not attached).
Omar B.: 2025-ENG-01 exists but its a USD PO for subscription only. Setup was not part of the PO. Also FYI the exchange rate on vendor calc uses 1.25 which doesn't match our FX table.
Elaine (AP): AP needs either (a) PO attached and currency note or (b) cost-owner approval for the setup + confirmation on FX. Who can approve the extra setup charge and the rate delta?
Dana M.: Omar is the cost owner for engineering vendor setup charges. Omar, can you approve and confirm GL coding?
Omar B.: I approve the setup line. Approval note to attach: "Omar B. approves HelioCore INV-9912 setup charge £1,200, GL=6305, cost center=ENG-OPS. Currency conversion per Redwood FX on 2025-09-15 (1.22) to USD." Will paste into invoice comments.
Priya S.: Please attach vendor email that references PO 2025-ENG-01 so AP can auto-match subscription lines. Ill also upload our FX calc showing 1.22; we'll let AP know the vendor rate discrepancy has been handled.
finance-bot: Invoice INV-9912 status updated: "held-no-po" -> "manual-review". Assigned approver: Omar B.
Elaine (AP): Once PO doc is attached we can auto-match subscription lines (PO 2025-ENG-01). With Omar's approval and FX note attached AP can route full payment. I'll need clear evidence we used 1.22 (screenshot or calc).
Dana M.: Uploaded vendor email with PO reference and attached the FX calc screenshot. Also noted to vendor to bill in USD moving forward.
Omar B.: Confirmed attachment added. Subscription matched to PO 2025-ENG-01. Setup approved as per note.
Elaine (AP): Marking INV-9912 ready for payment in next AP cycle. ETA: 4 business days. Please remind vendor to include PO on invoice header and bill in USD to avoid future holds. :memo:
Priya S.: Noted. I'll ping vendor ops to switch billing currency. Closing thread unless AP reopens.
